title: Removing Minimum and Maximum From Array
summary: Given a distinct integer array nums, identify the minimum and maximum values.
statement: Given a distinct integer array nums, identify the minimum and maximum values. The task is to remove both these values by either deleting from the start or end of the array. Determine the least deletions required to achieve this.
constraints: nums is nonempty and all values are distinct.
One deletion removes the current first or current last element.
Return the minimum deletions needed to remove both the original minimum and maximum.
hints: Only three strategies can be optimal: both from front, both from back, or one from each end.
Sort the two extreme indices as first and last, then evaluate those three deletion counts.
Any valid end-deletion sequence falls into one of these strategies; each formula is the exact minimum within its class.
editorial: Any valid end-deletion sequence falls into one of these strategies; each formula is the exact minimum within its class.

tests.explanation: Removing three from the front and two from the back removes both extremes in five deletions.
Removing three elements from the back and two from the front is optimal.
